summary: Changes tax_for so it returns None for an unknown region instead of zero tax.

findings.title: None return breaks checkout and receipt callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds the result to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100, and neither checks for None.
findings.consequence: Checkout raises TypeError for every order from an unknown region. Receipt printing raises the same error, where before both charged zero tax.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. If None is intended, update order_total and tax_line in the same change to handle it.

findings.title: No test covers the unknown region branch
findings.problem: The change adds a new return path to tax_for for unknown regions. No test in the repository runs tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: Without a test, nobody caught the caller breakage, and a future regression will also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with both a known region and an unknown region.
